description: Polyphonic source of chaotic sequences from four iterated maps: logistic, tent, circle and sawtooth

params.text: Sets how fast the map iterates while nothing is patched into Clk, -10V to 6V read as one octave per volt
The parameter of the map, 0 to 1, which is where the map moves between order and chaos
The starting value each sequence takes on a reset, 0.1 to 0.9
Picks the map: logistic, tent, circle or sawtooth

inputs.text: Raises the iteration rate by one octave per volt, and its channel count sets how many sequences run side by side while Clk is unpatched
Modulates the map parameter, 10V moving it by half its range when the attenuator beside it is fully up
Each rising edge iterates the map once; the channel count here sets how many sequences run side by side, and no interpolation is done between clocks
A rising edge sets every sequence back to its X0 starting value, which makes the sequence repeat
Adds to the starting value on a reset, one channel per sequence, one for one in volts, clamped to the range 0 to 1

outputs.text: The sequence, -5V to 5V, one channel per sequence

inputs.3: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
